provenance.notes: The package contains two native takes: idle and anima. All three combat styles use the original anima gesture with game-authored attack effects. The boss is stationary. Death uses a held native pose with game-authored crystal shatter/dissolve; no native death animation is claimed.

provenance.title: Demon Creature with Weapon — 25 animations, 2 skins
provenance.author: andriichykrii
provenance.notes: Original body, orb, default skin and rig retained. Twenty-six native takes inspected; ten runtime clips use reviewed single-cycle windows. The second phase adds a telepathic ring. No synthetic replacement body, weapon or animation.

provenance.title: Insectoid Monster Rig
provenance.motionNote: The supplied PoseLib is a landing/settling take and PoseLib.001 is static. Gameplay clips are authored by Emberfall on this exact rig; all curved B-bone segments are baked.

provenance.title: Prowler Dragon Variant Rig
provenance.modifications: Original topology and source colors; Blender curved bones baked, bind compensation for preserve-volume skinning, native walk cycle and new Emberfall combat motions. Full Blender PBR is not reproduced.
